decision: Keep 200 current records per page in descending sequence order with every version of each; continue with a Case-bound revision and sequence cursor; reject changed Cases as stale
why: A stable keyset avoids skips when business dates are corrected and a revision fence prevents mixing histories across writes

decision: Publish compact current sending facts from the complete exchange set for step summaries; generate the PDF from every record, independently of the screen page
why: Deadlines, sendings and PDF must agree without downloading every correction history on first screen load

decision: Acknowledge scoped Case command receipts separately from the live Case read; keep the current page decoder strict and reload the live Case after acknowledgement
why: Pre-upgrade immutable receipts lack pagination fields and must remain retryable without inventing complete historical sending facts

decision: Supersede repeatable-read Case pages with read-committed authorization and a shared Case row lock held through initial and continuation reads
why: The real journey demonstrated SQLSTATE40001 when concurrent actor resolution updates rows locked during captured permission rechecks; every Case command already takes its Case row for update, so the shared lock preserves one revision without changing Access semantics
